blocks.text: Each PDF carries a short check code, so an auditor can confirm the file hasn't changed since it was signed.
A signed inspection is never edited. A correction is a new inspection that points to the old one.
Was: nightly batch, Balcony to Mesh Routing.
Now: events, through a local queue on the device.
Each inspection is sent as one event when it is signed.
Events wait in a local queue on the device first. Nothing goes straight from the form to the network.
When the connection comes back, the queue drains on its own, oldest first.
Balcony keeps working when Mesh Routing is down or the tablet is offline. Nobody waits on the network to finish an inspection.
